# Local dictation on an Apple M2 MacBook Air: five systems

Measured 2026-10-31 15:05 PDT on **Apple M2**, 24.0 GB RAM, macOS-26.7.1-arm64-arm-64bit.

Corpus: 28 clips (112.8 s of audio): 19 main, 6 numeric, 1 long, 2 stress.

## Before you trust this

- **Handy · Parakeet Unified EN**: 'After that' is the engine's own inference timer, not wall time, and it excludes the model load each invocation pays. 'First phrase' is real wall time. Do not read the two columns as the same quantity.
- **Handy · Parakeet TDT v3**: 'After that' is the engine's own inference timer, not wall time, and it excludes the model load each invocation pays. 'First phrase' is real wall time. Do not read the two columns as the same quantity.
- **Handy · Whisper small.en**: 'After that' is the engine's own inference timer, not wall time, and it excludes the model load each invocation pays. 'First phrase' is real wall time. Do not read the two columns as the same quantity.

## Pros and cons

### NeMo-Speech · Parakeet TDT v3

- ✅ Most accurate everyday dictation on this machine (1.9% WER)
- ✅ Resident (no reload per phrase)
- ✅ Offline (no network)
- ⚠️ Misreads numbers (17.2% on the numbers group)

### Hex 3.0.0 · Parakeet v3

- ✅ Accurate enough for everyday use (1.9% WER)
- ✅ Resident (no reload per phrase)
- ✅ Offline (no network)
- ⚠️ No words while you speak
- ⚠️ No custom vocabulary
- ⚠️ Misreads numbers (17.2% on the numbers group)

### Handy · Parakeet Unified EN

- ✅ Accurate enough for everyday use (2.3% WER)
- ✅ Fastest after the first phrase (130 ms)
- ✅ Offline (no network)
- ⚠️ Slower first phrase (839 ms) than the rest (130 ms)
- ⚠️ Not resident: pays model-load cost for every invocation
- ⚠️ Misreads numbers (35.9% on the numbers group)

### Handy · Parakeet TDT v3

- ✅ Accurate enough for everyday use (2.3% WER)
- ✅ Offline (no network)
- ⚠️ Slow first phrase (1288 ms): the model is loaded per invocation, so every relaunch pays this once
- ⚠️ Not resident: pays model-load cost for every invocation
- ⚠️ Misreads numbers (31.2% on the numbers group)

### Handy · Whisper small.en

- ✅ Offline (no network)
- ⚠️ Least accurate everyday dictation here (2.3% WER)
- ⚠️ Slow first phrase (1974 ms): the model is loaded per invocation, so every relaunch pays this once
- ⚠️ Not resident: pays model-load cost for every invocation
- ⚠️ No custom vocabulary
- ⚠️ Misreads numbers (35.9% on the numbers group)

## What I would pick

- **You want it to just work, every phrase:** **Handy · Parakeet Unified EN** — tied on accuracy (2.3%) and fastest once running (130 ms).
- **You launch it once and dictate all day:** **NeMo-Speech · Parakeet TDT v3** — its first phrase after launch is the quickest (137 ms).
- **Nothing here shows words while you speak.** If that is what you are used to, these are all push-to-talk style: you get the text when you stop.

## What this does not tell you

- **Your voice and your microphone are not the test.** Default synthetic
  speakers are cleaner than a real room; real accuracy gaps tend to be larger.
  Use `dictation-bench corpus --from-clip recording.wav --ref "what you said"`.
- **Latency here is engine time, not the full felt wait.** Launching an app,
  audio capture, the paste keystroke and clipboard handling add tens to
  hundreds of milliseconds that no engine-level benchmark can see.
- **One run, one machine.** Re-run it if you care; that is the point.
